sectors.trend: Mixed: iron ore sentiment weak ('roaches seeth'), but lithium, gold, rare earths, and uranium exploration show strong momentum. Lithium miners cashing in on battery storage demand.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from soft iron ore sentiment. Lithium names (LIT.AX, SQM exposure) and gold explorers (GSG, KAL, INU) offer relative strength. Rare earths (LRE, BRK) gaining strategic policy tailwinds.

sectors.trend: Oil prices elevated on Iran/Middle East supply disruption; Asian refiners pivoting to Argentina. Goldman sees diesel margins at $63/bbl. Clean energy retreat by oil majors; wind and nuclear policy debates active.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, XVG.AX benefit from higher oil. Woodside (WDS.AX) and Santos (STO.AX) gain from LNG/oil price support. Clean energy names (SOL, IGN) face policy uncertainty. Coal/nuclear debate (One Nation) adds political noise.

sectors.trend: Rate expectations rising sharply; property investor credit growth crashes post-budget tax changes. Macquarie (MQG.AX) audit bid controversy. Insurance sector under ASIC scrutiny for short-changing claimants.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher rate environment but face NPL risk from property credit contraction. Insurance (CGU, WLR) faces regulatory pressure. MQG.AX governance overhang.

sectors.trend: Qantas strike risk weighs on QAN.AX. Woolworths (WES.AX) Tasmanian beef supply disruption. Major fruit grower layoffs signal agribusiness stress. EV uptake and weight-loss drug demand accelerating.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational disruption risk. WES.AX, WDW.AX supply chain adjustments. CSL.AX and healthcare names benefit from weight-loss drug demand. Consumer staples defensive appeal rising.

sectors.trend: Home values decline sharply; auction sentiment deteriorates; property investor credit growth crashes. Bathla (BTL.AX) near collapse. Star (SGH.AX) $307m loss with auditor going-concern doubts.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face valuation pressure. Property developers (BTL.AX, SGH.AX) high distress risk. Mortgage lenders exposed to NPL build-up.

sectors.trend: AI data centre boom driving PE trades; SpaceX disruption potential. Meta $24b settlement influenced by Australia's social media ban. ISCA AI Fluency Programme hits 15,000 enrolments.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (WTC.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from AI infrastructure capex. Data centre REITs gain. Meta settlement signals Australian regulatory leverage.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure from oil-driven inflation fears, property market weakness, and Qantas strike risk. Energy and banks outperform; property, REITs, and speculative small-caps lag. Rate expectation volatility dominates. Expect 2-4% index volatility over coming weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if Middle East tensions de-escalate and RBA holds. Critical minerals (lithium, rare earths, uranium) and AI infrastructure offer structural growth. Property correction may stabilise by H2 2027. Political uncertainty around energy transition (coal/nuclear) adds policy risk. Banks remain core holdings on dividend yield.
